stemBlocks: Diagram 1 shows the positions of nine equally spaced particles in a medium. Diagram 2 shows the positions of the same nine particles, at a particular time, while a longitudinal wave is travelling through the medium.
What is the amplitude of the wave?

assets.alt: Diagram 1 shows initial particle positions. Diagram 2 shows particle positions with a longitudinal wave. Both diagrams show distance along medium /m on the x-axis.
